name: GlzTextField
semanticRole: Collect and edit a short text value with persistent labeling, validation, and predictable keyboard semantics.

material.rule: Standard or filled surfaces are default. Glaze fields are limited to floating search or overlay contexts where spatial context materially helps.

input.keyboard: Uses native text-editing semantics, selection, Home/End and platform shortcuts; Enter behavior is defined by the containing form rather than invented by the field.
input.focus: Focus strengthens the field boundary and label relationship without removing the persistent label.
input.hover: Hover may strengthen the boundary slightly but never substitutes for focus.
input.press: Pointer/touch press positions the caret or selects text according to native editing conventions.
input.selection: Text selection follows platform conventions and remains visible in high contrast.

accessibility.name: A persistent external or floating label provides the accessible name; placeholder text is never the sole label.
accessibility.state: Disabled, read-only, required, invalid, loading where applicable, and focus state are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: Current text value is exposed through native input semantics.
accessibility.keyboard: Full native text editing, selection, clipboard, and form navigation are preserved.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains visible at all contrast/transparency settings and is never encoded by color alone.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Invalid state programmatically associates a concise explanation with the field; error uses boundary/icon/message rather than a saturated red container.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Floating-label or validation transitions use direct/short opacity movement; no required large motion.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Glaze variant becomes opaque while keeping label, border, and state hierarchy.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Boundary, caret, focus, selection, and error treatment strengthen.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform field/background/text/focus/error semantics and retain associated error text.
accessibility.largeText: Label and support/error text reflow; text is not clipped vertically; fields may grow when necessary.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Direct label/state transition or short crossfade.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Platform field and focus colors with programmatic error association intact.
fallbacks.performance: Remove optional blur/shadow before altering input geometry or editing behavior.

content.overflow: User-entered text scrolls or reflows according to native single-line behavior; labels and validation text must not be silently clipped.
content.localization: Labels, placeholders, support text, errors, prefixes, suffixes, and input formatting support locale-aware content.
content.rtl: Text direction follows content/locale; leading/trailing adornments mirror semantically without reversing typed data that has intrinsic direction.

criteria: Label remains obvious before, during, and after entry.
Error state is unmistakable without becoming a saturated red block.
Compact and standard densities preserve readable caret/text alignment.
Glaze variant is limited to genuinely floating contexts.
